name: Fujiwara no Misono
source:
A member of the Star Clan who supplies exposition for understanding the game's setting. Misono is gifted with the ability to read the flow of energy
Family: Father and mother (deceased), Grandfather (deceased), Shijo no Amakimi (grandmother), Akifumi's mother (step great-aunt, deceased), Yukari (twin sister)
Occupation: Aristocrat
